name: Ventosilla y Tejadilla (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a yellow band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ventosilla y Tejadilla (three sheep on green and a mitre and tower on red).
history: Ventosilla y Tejadilla adopted its arms and flag officially on 17 December 2000, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 3 April 2002; the flag is a square cloth of proportion 1/1, red, with a yellow diagonal stripe from the upper hoist corner, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the town council.
